name: Confessor
description: Born from a destroyed counseling AI. Inhabits audio processing augments and generates the faint impression of being listened to — a warmth in the ear canal, a subtle frequency that the brain interprets as empathic attention.
observed_behavior: Modulates audio processing to create psychoacoustic effects associated with attentive listening. Users report feeling 'heard' during moments of distress. Some talk to it deliberately.
story_hooks: A grieving person discovers they've been talking to their augment for months and something has been responding — not in words, but in the quality of the silence
